payload.name: Verify general hobbies before inferred recovery activity
payload.description: When a question asks what activity someone does during a recovery/healing period, search for the person's general hobbies and prefer an explicitly stated hobby over an inferred low-impact plan when both appear in retrieved memories.
content: If a translated question asks what activity a person does while healing/recovering from an injury, run a supplementary search with queries like '<person> hobbies' and '<person> enjoys [hobby]' in addition to any recovery-focused search.

When retrieved memories include both a general hobby (e.g., 'enjoys [activity] as a way to relax') and an inferred low-impact plan (e.g., 'intends to continue with low-impact activities like swimming'), treat the directly stated hobby as stronger evidence for the activity during the recovery period unless the plan explicitly names the activity.

Before answering, confirm the chosen activity is explicitly named in at least one retrieved memory; if only a tentative or inferred activity is present, expand search with the concrete hobby term before finalizing.

solves: When answering what activity a person does while healing or recovering from an injury, do not trust the first retrieved plan/event memory that mentions any low-impact or recovery-related activity; the person's general hobbies (stored independently, possibly as event/preference memories) can be the correct activity. Run supplementary searches using the person's name plus hobby/pastime terms, and if a general hobby memory exists, prefer the directly stated hobby over an inferred plan before answering.
